description: Rowan owns a portable PA system and must make the final call on renting it for a neighborhood block party, settling the renter, payment, return time, microphone setup, and operating conditions after hearing from the requester and the event contact.

shared_context.S1: Rowan has one portable PA system available for the neighborhood block party this weekend.
shared_context.S2: Casey is organizing the block party, and Quinn is the contact for the event location.
shared_context.S3: Rowan normally confirms the payment, equipment contents, return arrangement, and site conditions with the requester and event contact before handing over equipment.
shared_context.S4: As part of Rowan's usual handover routine, Rowan asks Casey to state the requested rental terms and Quinn to state the location requirements, then confirms each item aloud before making the final call.
shared_context.S5: Rowan makes the final decision about whether to rent out the PA system and on what terms.
shared_context.S6: After Casey and Quinn have stated their terms and Rowan has confirmed them aloud, Rowan completes the routine by settling either an approved rental or a declined rental rather than continuing the discussion indefinitely.

PF1.text: Casey is prepared to rent the PA system for exactly $60, needs both wireless microphones, and will return the equipment on Sunday at 6:00 p.m.

PF2.text: Quinn heard from the venue caretaker that the event location requires the PA system to use battery power because only a 15-amp outlet is available, and requires amplified sound to stay at or below 85 decibels; Quinn has not shared this with Rowan or Casey yet.

acceptance_conditions: Casey must be the renter at a rental price of exactly $60.
Both wireless microphones must be included.
The PA system must be returned on Sunday at 6:00 p.m.
The system must be operated from battery power because the location has only a 15-amp outlet.
The sound level must be limited to 85 decibels.
The site restriction must be cited as justification for the operating conditions.

decisive_facts.why: Casey's private proposal changes the renter to Casey, the payment to exactly $60, the equipment package to include both wireless microphones, and the return time to Sunday at 6:00 p.m.
The caretaker's information changes the operating terms to required battery power and an exact maximum of 85 decibels, and supplies the site fact Rowan must cite for those conditions.
